verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents an MCP Server for connecting AI tools (langfuse-docs-39, langfuse-docs-50) and a CLI designed for use from a coding agent (langfuse-docs-30). A user can therefore drive the product with natural language, but only indirectly through an external AI agent, not through a built-in command interface. The Docs MCP (langfuse-docs-19, langfuse-docs-36) mainly helps a coding agent integrate tracing into code rather than operate Langfuse itself. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server and CLI expose to agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
